pipeline.signal_source: Existence: flat-region luminance variance p75 (thr8 low-gradient patches) target 0.10/0.19 (pairs 0/2) vs no-noise sim 0.05/0.05; R0 flat-region p50 8.16/7.95/11.66 (pairs 0-2) vs no-noise sims 0.45/0.00/1.82; chroma std +5-20% over no-noise sims in 5/5. Type NOT identifiable under noise->blur (SKILL: 54.7% ~ random); cross_channel_corr 0.57-0.87 is JPEG-confounded. Impulse explicitly rejected: raw impulse_zero_ratio 0.039-0.098 << 0.85 sparsity fingerprint; peeled extreme_pct 80-90% is a sign artifact (residual spatial_corr 0.97, ivc 0.89, 80% pixels of one sign), extreme-flag also fires on a no-impulse strip; impulse sim leaves flat-region p75 0.05 vs target 0.10 (sparse s&p does not reproduce the target's distributed flat noise). Severity 3 kept: after dropping the contrast step the simulated variance ratio matches target on all 5 pairs (0.772/0.645/0.748/0.714/0.732 vs target 0.711/0.639/0.734/0.700/0.706).

Signal-level match on the noise-robust blur checks: spectral_slope diff 0.0315/0.0348 (<0.08) and Wiener kernel corr 0.9989/0.9984 (>0.85) on pairs 0/2 (R1 candidate pipeline). gm_ratio 0.17-0.50 and spectral_slope_ratio 1.20-1.28 in 5/5. Not motion: residual_anisotropy 1.15-1.67 < 1.7. Glass_score 1.15-1.54 is below/at the no-blur JPEG sim range 1.44-1.86 -> GLASS verdict is a JPEG-confounded FP. gaussian vs lens MTF-indistinguishable (MEMORY); gaussian wins the R0 matched grid (30.70 vs 29.73 dB) and keeps lens as alternative. Severity 3 from gm_ratio calibration (target 0.164 vs gauss3+jpeg5 0.143, gauss4 0.104, gauss2 0.227) and R0 gauss2/4 scans.

block_boundary 4.24-7.15 in 5/5 pairs (0% FP signal) plus dct_zero_ratio 0.892-0.948. Severity 4 (q8) retained after R1 re-test: jpeg5 (q5) matched pair2 block_boundary (diff 1.8%) but broke pair0 (diff 40% vs 10-13% for jpeg4) and degraded chroma on both (pair2 Cr/Cb 4.63/3.75 vs target 5.02/5.63; pair0 q5 Cr 9.45 vs target 7.10 per R0 calibration). jpeg4 is the best cross-pair compromise; severity uncertainty borders sev5 but SEV+-1 JPEG costs ~0.2 dB per REFLECTION_MECHANISM.

removed_steps.signal_source: R0 attributed variance_ratio 0.64-0.73 (vs blur+jpeg 0.75-0.92) plus an anchor-128 mean-shift affine fit (implied alpha 0.85-0.90) to a contrast step. R1 falsifies this with matched simulations: noise_YCrCb3+blur3+jpeg4 WITHOUT any global step reproduces the target variance ratio on all 5 pairs (0.772/0.645/0.748/0.714/0.732 vs 0.711/0.639/0.734/0.700/0.706; mean within 0.3-2.0 levels, std within 0.2-1.7), because clipping of the strong pre-blur YCrCb noise supplies the apparent mid-gray contraction. The library's mildest contrast_weaken_scale (alpha=0.75) overshoots to variance ratio 0.437/0.419 (pairs 0/2) vs target 0.711/0.734 and inflates the peeled-residual autocorr FWHM from 8-12px (no contrast) to 62-334px. Library cannot represent the residual ~alpha>=0.96 contraction; omitting the step is the closest representable approximation.

analysis.psnr_gap_note: R1 minus R0-4step sim PSNR on the two pairs where both were measured (pair0 +1.82, pair2 +2.70 dB); decisive evidence is signal-level (variance-ratio mismatch 95-118% -> 1.4-8.6%, residual FWHM 62-334px -> 6-12px)
